_about: Phrasings with the rule they should mean, for scripts/eval_rule_behaviour.py. 'reference' is the IR the sentence must be equivalent to on the eval school; 'expect': 'ask' means the right answer is a question back. Names must exist in the eval school (see the script). Add a case for every misreading fixed from the admin Rule reading page. Cases with split 'held_out' must never be added to the parser's worked examples: their score is the honest measure of how well it reads sentences it has not seen.
